bounds.notes: Players and the core are clamped inside; enemies may start up to 50 units outside.

goals.notes: A core and a drop zone spawn together; the zone position is in the drop_zone object. Delivery = core centre inside the zone for 90 game units (~0.7 s).

tasks.text: Carry the Void Core together to the drop zone.
Hold E next to your downed partner to revive them.
Survive the waves until the timer ends.

success: survive until the timer ends; each delivered core is a sub-goal
